clues: This town is the chief and most peopled town of its land. It stands where two great rivers meet and flow on as one.
Rain shuns this town for some eight months of the year. Its long dry time splits in two: a warm dry part, then a very hot dry part.
This town was set up in 1821 by a great lord of the east. He set it north of a far more old town of stone.
This town is one of three bound by bridge spans where two great streams join. Folk call that meet-point by a name that means The Joining.
The great town zone round here holds more than seven million folk. It is the most big town zone of the whole land.
